verdict: M8-B RESOLVED, exactly and without periods. The arithmetic supplies a canonical complex structure on exactly one block: JJ = (U_13 - 2)/3 on the 11a1 ghost, because the oldspace degeneracy prime has discriminant a_13^2 - 4*13 = -36 < 0. It has order 4, so it is not subject to the M8-A reality obstruction that kills Atkin-Lehner, the star involution and every Galois sign. Pairing the M7 graph coupling against it gives an EXACT rational CP-odd amplitude with nonzero antilinear part, while the Hecke operators themselves have antilinear part exactly zero. So the CP-odd channel is not merely open (M8-A) but carries a computable, zero-parameter amplitude on the sector where the level factorizes. The Hodge-structure magnitudes on the three remaining blocks are genuinely transcendental and still require the period matrix in the modular-symbol basis; that is the successor task.
